bagPolicy.summary: Bags no larger than 5” x 9” are permitted, along with diaper and medical bags, which are subject to search upon entry. Strollers are not allowed inside Target Center.
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are allowed but subject to search.

parking.note: Parking is available at Ramps A, B, and C, with reservations recommended through SpotHero for discounts up to 50% off. Be aware of ongoing construction affecting I-94 and I-394.

rideshare.note: For accessible pickup and drop-off, use 1st Avenue and 6th Street by the Life Time Lobby.

concessions.note: Target Center offers a diverse range of food options, including new stands and traditional favorites. Highlights include chef-driven dishes, local ingredients, and unique offerings like the French Onion Dog, S’more Nachos, and a variety of international and comfort foods.
stands: 118 Bibigo / Ben’s Pretzels / Maui Wowi & Cold Stone
126 Next Up Kitchen / Walking Taco / Rolling Smoke

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: There is a drop-off lane on 1st Avenue in front of the building, elevators to all levels, and designated disability seating. If you need an elevator, park in Ramp A or B and enter on the skyway level. A sensory room and sensory bags are available through Guest Services outside section 116; call Guest Services at 612-673-1380 with questions.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office is open Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 10 AM to 6 PM and doesn't accept cash or Apple Pay. Tickets are sold on AXS.com or Ticketmaster.com, depending on the show.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Target Center's main gate entrance is located on skyway level.
